mapper.select: SELECT SUBSTRING(code FROM 1 FOR 2) AS region_code, code AS dtl_region_code FROM region WHERE LENGTH(code) = 5 AND isactive IS TRUE ORDER BY code ASC

INSERT INTO library ( lib_code, name, address, tel, fax, homepage, latitude, longitude, closed_days, operating_time, book_count, location, region_code, dtl_region_code ) VALUES ( #{libCode}, #{name}, #{address}, #{tel}, #{fax}, #{homepage}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{closedDays}, #{operatingTime}, #{bookCount},
ST_SetSRID( ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4326 )::geography
NULL
, #{regionCode}, #{dtlRegionCode} )
ON CONFLICT (lib_code) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, address = EXCLUDED.address, tel = EXCLUDED.tel, fax = EXCLUDED.fax, homepage = EXCLUDED.homepage, latitude = EXCLUDED.latitude, longitude = EXCLUDED.longitude, location = EXCLUDED.location, closed_days = EXCLUDED.closed_days, operating_time = EXCLUDED.operating_time, book_count = EXCLUDED.book_count, region_code = EXCLUDED.region_code, dtl_region_code = EXCLUDED.dtl_region_code, updated_at = NOW() RETURNING (xmax = 0) AS inserted

SELECT lib_code, name, address, tel, fax, homepage, latitude, longitude, closed_days, operating_time, book_count, dtl_region_code,
ST_Distance( location, ST_SetSRID( ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4326 )::geography ) AS distance
NULL AS distance
FROM library
ORDER BY distance, name
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT lib_code, name, address, latitude, longitude, dtl_region_code,
ST_Distance( location, ST_SetSRID( ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4326 )::geography ) AS distance
NULL AS distance
FROM library
ORDER BY distance, name
LIMIT 500
SELECT lib_code, name, address, tel, fax, homepage, latitude, longitude, closed_days, operating_time, book_count, region_code, dtl_region_code FROM library WHERE lib_code = #{libCode}
